name: menubar
title: Menubar
description: Desktop-style horizontal menu bar with the same item parts and styles as the Dropdown Menu, built on Reka UI.

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { MenubarRootEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import type { MenubarProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { MenubarRoot, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<MenubarProps>(), {
  loop: true,
})
const emits = defineEmits<MenubarRootEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class')
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <MenubarRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="menubar"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('flex h-10 w-fit max-w-full items-center gap-1 rounded-md border bg-background p-1 shadow-xs md:h-9', props.class)"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </MenubarRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { MenubarContentEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import type { MenubarContentProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { MenubarContent, MenubarPortal, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { menuContentClass } from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu'

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<MenubarContentProps>(), {
  align: 'start',
  alignOffset: -4,
  sideOffset: 8,
})
const emits = defineEmits<MenubarContentEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class')
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <MenubarPortal>
    <MenubarContent
      data-slot="menubar-content"
      v-bind="{ ...$attrs, ...forwarded }"
      :class="cn(
        menuContentClass,
        'min-w-48 max-h-(--reka-menubar-content-available-height) origin-(--reka-menubar-content-transform-origin)',
        props.class,
      )"
    >
      <slot />
    </MenubarContent>
  </MenubarPortal>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { MenubarGroupProps } from 'reka-ui'

</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { MenubarItemEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import type { MenubarItemProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { menuItemVariants } from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<MenubarItemProps>(), {
  variant: 'default',
})
const emits = defineEmits<MenubarItemEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class', 'variant', 'inset')
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <MenubarItem
    data-slot="menubar-item"
    :data-variant="props.variant"
    :data-inset="props.inset ? '' : undefined"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn(menuItemVariants({ variant: props.variant }), props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </MenubarItem>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">

<script setup lang="ts">
